Two things need the CRM system: Atlas has no deal record yet, and no customer portal exists. I'll confirm both back to you once done.

YOUR NAMED PRIORITIES TODAY (revenue-first):
1. TERRA LOTUS $78,580 — day 8 unsent, biggest money on the board. I need one thing from you: the contact name + address. Give me that and it goes out today (deposit $39,290).
2. ATLAS $26,500 — money's in. Confirm production kickoff/schedule so I can set the balance-collection follow-up.
3. OREKA $8,555 — one yes/no from you to authorize the payment + 1,000-unit Peptide Cream job.
4. THREE HOT CALLS THIS WEEK — Hass Alamer (2,000 units, wants a Tue call), Gisela Uriarte / AMR Labs (Tue/Wed Zoom), Jarrod Adams / Shay Brands (90% per Fri briefing). These are yours to close.
5. ADS ONE-CLICK FIX — both new campaigns are on Maximize Conversions with zero tracked conversions (burning money). Say 'revert ads to manual' and I flip both back, under cap.

Bottom line: Terra Lotus is the single highest-value move — your one input (name + address) unlocks a $39,290 deposit today.
spoken_text: Sam, good news first. Atlas already paid the fifty percent deposit, thirteen thousand two hundred fifty dollars, and it's in our records from August seventh. I've handed the CRM Developer two jobs: get that deposit recorded in the system and set up Ryne's customer portal and login so we can send it to him. I'll confirm when both are done. Now your priorities today. Number one, and it's the big one, is Terra Lotus at seventy-eight thousand dollars. It's been sitting unsent for eight days, and all I need from you is the contact name and address, then it goes out today for a thirty-nine thousand dollar deposit. After that, confirm Atlas production so I can chase the balance, give me a yes or no on Oreka, and there are three hot calls this week that only you can close. My recommendation: give me the Terra Lotus name and address right now. That's the fastest money on the board.
